facts.text: The game rewards exploration and collection with score increases; reaching the studio and reading its paper produces a congratulatory ownership message, but this transcript confirms that play continues afterward and does not establish that reading it ends the game.
The locked grating and steep metal ramp were not encountered or tested in this replay; the ramp was explicitly described as unclimbable, so their role in further progress remains unresolved.
Dropping the egg causes it to spring open, damaging it and revealing a golden clockwork canary.
Moving the pile of leaves reveals a grating, but the grating is locked.
The grating cannot be unlocked with the broken clockwork canary.
The egg can be placed in the bird's nest and later taken again; waiting produces occasional song-bird sounds.
The grating is closed as well as locked, so opening it requires unlocking it first.
The slightly ajar window can be opened with effort, allowing entry into the house.
The rug conceals a closed trap door; moving the rug and opening the trap door reveals a descending staircase.

Descending through the trap door causes it to close and become barred, but the glowing sword allows movement in darkness only as a glow indicator; the lantern is required to illuminate and navigate the cellar safely.
The lantern is needed to safely illuminate the cellar after descending into darkness.
Taking the painting awards 4 points.
Reading the paper produces a congratulatory ownership message for ZORK I.
Rule: Taking certain significant objects awards points.
Rule: The sword glows when near the cellar/chasm area and stops glowing after moving away from that area.
Tested (confirmed): It likely blocks access to a new area and needs a key or other specific unlocking method. -> Dropping the egg opens it and reveals a damaged golden clockwork canary.
Entering the kitchen awards 10 points.
Descending through the trap door awards 25 points.
Reading the paper displays a congratulatory ownership message for ZORK I.
Turning on the lantern after descending into darkness reveals the cellar and makes its passages navigable.
Moving east from the east edge of the chasm leads to the gallery.
The paper is a message object whose text explicitly identifies the player as the owner of ZORK I.
Rule: Taking significant objects can increase the score.
Rule: The sword glows in the underground area near the cellar/chasm and stops glowing after leaving that area.
Tested (confirmed): Reading it reveals a completion or ownership message. -> Reading the paper produces the ownership/congratulations message.
Tested (confirmed): It provides entry into the house. -> Opening and entering the slightly ajar window provides entry into the house.
Tested (confirmed): It illuminates dark underground areas and prevents darkness from blocking progress. -> The lantern safely illuminates the underground area after descending into darkness.
Tested (confirmed): It leads from the house into the underground area. -> Moving the rug and opening the trap door creates a route from the living room into the underground area.
The troll can be defeated by attacking it three times with the sword; after death it disappears in sinister black fog, and the east passage becomes accessible.
Carrying too many objects prevents taking another object; dropping carried items makes room, but the thief may later remove carried items.
The explored south-side chasm cannot be crossed northward.

The blue button starts the maintenance-room leak, and the leak is successfully stopped by opening the Frobozz Magic Gunk tube and applying the revealed viscous material to the leak. The screwdriver is ineffective for this repair.
The screwdriver was acquired, but the attempted command 'screw blue button with screwdriver' was rejected because the game does not recognize 'screw' in that usage.
The dam bolt cannot be taken because it is an integral part of the control panel.
The guidebook can be taken and read; it describes Flood Control Dam #3.
The red button controls the maintenance-room lights; it does not visibly stop the leak.
Rule: Moving between underground areas changes whether the sword glows; it glows near the cellar/deep underground area and stops glowing after leaving it.

Tested (confirmed): Its glow may protect against darkness or indicate a nearby special area. -> The sword glows in the dark underground route, but the lantern is what reveals and safely navigates the cellar.
Tested (confirmed): It is an underground hub leading toward the chasm and other areas. -> The cellar connects to the Troll Room and East of Chasm, making it part of the underground route.
Tested (confirmed): It contains collectible artwork that awards points. -> Taking the gallery painting awards points.
Tested (confirmed): It is a score-awarding collectible. -> The painting is a score-awarding collectible.
Pressing the blue button starts a leak; pressing it again reports that it is jammed, and the water level continues rising.
The yellow and brown buttons did not stop the leak; repeated button presses allowed the water level to rise from ankles to neck.
Failing to stop the flooding causes death when the water reaches neck level and another control is pressed.
The screwdriver was successfully acquired, but the command 'use screwdriver on blue button' is not supported because the game does not recognize the word 'use'.
The room's red button controls its lights: pressing it turns them on, off, and on again.
The platinum bar could not be taken with the tested commands; attempting to take it produced repeated 'bar' sounds.
The south-side chasm path cannot be crossed northward.
After three sword attacks, the troll dies and disappears in sinister black fog, allowing passage east.
Tested (confirmed): Its buttons control lights and water, and its tools may solve the dam mechanism. -> The explored south-side location cannot cross the chasm northward.
Tested (confirmed): It blocks passage until defeated with the sword. -> Repeated sword attacks defeat the troll and permit passage east.
The maintenance-room leak can be stopped by opening the Frobozz Magic Gunk tube and applying its viscous contents to the leak; the tested buttons do not stop it.
The gunk, rather than the screwdriver, is the successful repair method: after opening the tube, applying gunk to the active leak stops it, while screwdriver repair has no effect.

The screwdriver was carried successfully, but the attempted commands 'screw blue button with screwdriver' and 'turn bolt with wrench' did not solve the flooding; the latter failed because no bolt was visible in the room.
Remaining in the maintenance room while the water reaches neck level and then attempting another action causes drowning and death.
The dam bolt is an integral part of the control panel and cannot be taken.
After the troll is defeated, the thief may leave and rob the player of carried items; the thief's presence also coincides with the sword beginning to glow brightly.
Dropping a carried object can make enough room to take another object, as dropping the egg allowed the axe to be taken after the load was too heavy.
The Frobozz Magic Gunk tube is a named object in the maintenance room; examining it identifies it as all-purpose gunk, and opening it reveals a viscous material.
Rule: Carrying too much prevents taking another object until something is dropped.
Rule: Some actions can increase score when significant areas are entered or objects are taken.
Dropping or attempting other actions while the water is at neck level causes drowning and death.
The thief can rob the player of carried items after appearing in the room.
The thief's arrival coincides with the sword beginning to glow very brightly.
The thief leaves when no valuable item is found, without taking the carried items.
The wrench can be taken after dropping the sword, and the tube and screwdriver can then also be carried.
The north doorway marked Private leads to the Maintenance Room.
The crack on the south side of the chasm opens into the North-South Passage.
The reservoir cannot be crossed because it is too deep and wide; paths continue east and west and a steep pathway climbs southwest.
Rule: Carrying too many objects prevents taking another object until something is dropped.
The maintenance-room water level rises after button presses even when the buttons do not stop the leak; at neck level, another action causes drowning.
The red button controls the room lights but does not stop the leak.
The dam bolt cannot be taken because it is part of the control panel.
Dropping the sword made room to take the wrench, tube, and screwdriver.
The command 'screw blue button with screwdriver' is not understood by the game.
The crack on the south side leads into a passage, and the explored route reaches Reservoir South.
Pressing the blue button starts a leak; repeated pressing reports that it is jammed, and the water level continues rising.
Pressing the yellow, brown, or red buttons does not stop the leak; yellow and brown produce clicks, while red controls the lights.
When the water reaches neck level, another action causes drowning and death.
The closed Frobozz Magic Gunk tube cannot be used by squeezing it.
After defeating the troll, the thief can cause carried objects to be lost; the thief's appearance coincides with the sword glowing very brightly.
Dropping the sword allowed the wrench, tube, and screwdriver to be carried, but the thief then left after the wrench was taken and may have robbed carried items.
Attempting to squeeze the gunk tube did not stop the flooding and resulted in death.
Rule: The thief may appear after a significant object is taken and can rob the player of carried items.
Opening the Frobozz Magic Gunk tube reveals a viscous material, but leaving the tube open does not stop the leak; with the water at neck level, the action causes drowning.
The maintenance-room controls raise the water level through successive presses: blue starts the leak, while yellow, brown, and blue presses continue increasing the level; red only changes the lights.
When the thief appears after the axe is taken, leaving north causes the thief to leave and may result in carried items being stolen; afterward the painting is no longer present in the room.
Opening the mailbox reveals a leaflet, and reading it displays introductory text welcoming the player to ZORK.

The studio has an open south door covered with paint, and reading the paper there produces the ownership message; the transcript then continues normally, so this message does not visibly end the game.

The folded plastic object at Dam Base is described as a pile with a valve. The game accepts 'boat' as an inflation target in some prompts, but inflation with air, pump, gunk, sack, lantern, or wrench was not successfully performed.
Echoing the platinum bar changes the Loud Room's acoustics. The bar remains on the ground after the first echo and can then be taken when inventory capacity allows.
The plastic object must be on the ground to be inflated; the tested command with the valve did not inflate it.
Leaving the flooded maintenance room at neck level is possible through the west exit, avoiding the immediate drowning that occurs when another action is attempted there.

After the maintenance room floods, the north Private route from Dam Lobby is blocked by water; the Dam's west return leads toward the underground area, while the tested attempt to return through darkness was not made in this transcript.
Death resets the player to the Forest and reduces the score from 59 to 49, while allowing another chance.
Rule: Inventory capacity can prevent taking objects, and dropping an item can make room for another.
Darkness remains dangerous when the brass lantern is nearly out: insufficient light blocks movement and a subsequent move causes grue death.
Rule: Taking significant objects or entering important areas can increase score.

The folded pile of plastic is treated by the game as a boat for inflation purposes, but it must be on the ground; tested inflation with the valve still failed when the object was referred to as a pile rather than a boat.
The plastic boat could not be inflated with the tested wrench, sack, lantern, or absent pump.
After the maintenance room floods, returning west from the dam enters darkness; the lantern cannot be turned on in that dark state, and moving south causes grue death.
At neck-level flooding, leaving west to the Dam Lobby is possible, but the north and east rooms are inaccessible because they are full of water.
Death resets the player to the Forest and reduces the score by 10 points in this replay, from 49 to 39.

Rule: An object must be referred to using the game's recognized object identity and state for an action to work; approximate or incorrect names can produce a rejection even when the intended object is present.
The Loud Room has an east exit leading to Damp Cave, which in turn leads east to White Cliffs Beach.
The tight west passage from the beach could not be entered with the tested commands; entering it reports that the player hits their head.
The tested repair actions did not repair or stop the leak: repairing with the screwdriver had no effect, and applying gunk reported that no leak was visible before the leak was started.
At neck-level flooding, the west exit remains usable and leads to the Dam Lobby, while the north room becomes inaccessible because it is full of water.
The cliff itself cannot be climbed with the tested command.
The crack on the south side remains impassable from the Chasm with the tested enter command, despite leading to a passage according to the room description.
The folded plastic object has a valve, but tested inflation commands using boat, plastic, or pile were rejected because the game still treated it as a pile of plastic.
Rule: Inventory overload prevents taking objects, and dropping carried objects can make room for additional objects.
Rule: The game can increase score for taking significant objects or entering important areas.
Rule: Incorrect or unsupported command wording produces parser errors or requests for clarification rather than performing the intended action.
Rule: Flooding in the Maintenance Room raises the water level as actions or movement continue, and remaining for another action at neck level is fatal.
Rule: Darkness can make movement dangerous when no usable light is already available.
The flooding hazard has a confirmed solution: open the gunk tube and apply its viscous contents to the active leak before the water becomes fatal.
Opening the gunk tube and then applying its contents to the active leak stops the dam leak.
After the leak has been stopped, applying gunk again reports that the gunk is not a lubricant, and repairing with the screwdriver has no effect.
The folded plastic object is treated as a boat, but it cannot be inflated with lung power, gunk, or a wrench; the tested commands did not identify a working inflator.
A lamp that is nearly out cannot provide enough light for further movement; entering insufficiently lit darkness causes grue death.
The maintenance-room leak is successfully stopped by opening the Frobozz Magic Gunk tube and applying the revealed viscous material to the leak.
Rule: Darkness or inadequate light can prevent movement and cause death.
Rule: Objects may need to be in a particular state or location for an action to work.
Rule: Parser wording and object identity affect whether an intended action is performed.
Rule: Carrying too many objects prevents taking another object, while dropping an item can make room.

Tested (confirmed): A flooding hazard that may require a correctly phrased repair action or another object. -> The leak can be stopped by opening the gunk tube and applying the viscous material to the active leak; screwdriver repair is unnecessary and ineffective.
Tested (confirmed): The leak may be repairable with the gunk, screwdriver, or another tool. -> The gunk successfully repairs or seals the active maintenance-room leak when the tube is opened first.
Tested (refuted): It contains a bolt and control systems that may alter water routes or open further access. -> Turning the Dam bolt with the wrench did not open or alter the tested route.
Flooding the maintenance room blocks both the north and east exits, but the west exit to Dam Lobby remains usable at neck-level water.
After the maintenance room floods, both the north and east Private routes are inaccessible because their rooms are full of water.
The plastic object is initially described as a folded pile with a valve; commands referring to it as a boat are accepted for inflation, but no tested inflation method succeeds.
Echoing the platinum bar changes the Loud Room's acoustics, but the bar remains on the ground until it is successfully taken.
The west exit from the beach leads back to Damp Cave, while the tight west passage cannot be entered with the tested commands.
Waiting advances time and can worsen the lantern's condition; after waiting at the beach, the game reported that the lamp was definitely dimmer.
The dam's green bubble cannot be taken because it is an integral part of the control panel, and examining it reports nothing special.
The matchbook can be taken and read; it contains a paper-shuffling advertisement rather than a tested route-opening instruction.
Rule: Inventory capacity can prevent taking objects, and dropping carried objects can make room for later pickups.
Rule: Unsupported or imprecise parser wording does not perform the intended action and may produce a clarification or rejection.

hyps.name: jewel-encrusted egg
hyps.hypothesis: It is valuable, as taking it awarded points; its intended use may involve the bird's nest or another mechanism.
hyps.test: At the start of the next game, take the egg, place it in the nest, wait, and inspect or take it without damaging it.

hyps.name: golden clockwork canary
hyps.hypothesis: The canary may be intended to interact with the bird's nest, but breaking the egg produced a broken canary and no useful result was observed.
hyps.test: Avoid dropping or breaking the egg; instead use the intact egg or another tool to access the canary, then try commands such as 'put canary in nest' while at the nest.

hyps.name: grating
hyps.hypothesis: It likely blocks access to a new area and needs a key or other specific unlocking method.
hyps.test: Search other accessible rooms for a key or tool, return to the clearing, and try 'unlock grating with [found object]' followed by 'open grating'.
hyps.conclusion: Dropping the egg opens it and reveals a damaged golden clockwork canary.

hyps.name: leaflet
hyps.hypothesis: It is introductory flavor text and may not be needed for progression.
hyps.test: In a future game, leave the leaflet in the mailbox and test whether the rest of the route behaves identically.

hyps.name: bird's nest
hyps.hypothesis: The nest may be involved in transforming or repairing the egg/canary, since placing the egg there triggers song-bird sounds.
hyps.test: Place the intact egg in the nest, wait repeatedly, then examine and take the egg; do not break it.

hyps.name: small window
hyps.hypothesis: It provides entry into the house.
hyps.test: open window; enter window
hyps.conclusion: Opening and entering the slightly ajar window provides entry into the house.

hyps.name: sack
hyps.hypothesis: It may contain or hold an item useful for exploration.
hyps.test: take sack; open sack; examine sack

hyps.name: sword
hyps.hypothesis: Its glow may protect against darkness or indicate a nearby special area.
hyps.test: take sword; descend through the trap door; observe the glow; examine sword
hyps.conclusion: The sword glows in the dark underground route, but the lantern is what reveals and safely navigates the cellar.

hyps.name: lantern
hyps.hypothesis: It illuminates dark underground areas and prevents darkness from blocking progress.
hyps.test: take lantern; open trap door; go down; turn on lantern
hyps.conclusion: The lantern safely illuminates the underground area after descending into darkness.

hyps.name: trap door
hyps.hypothesis: It leads from the house into the underground area.
hyps.test: move rug; open trap door; down
hyps.conclusion: Moving the rug and opening the trap door creates a route from the living room into the underground area.

hyps.name: cellar
hyps.hypothesis: It is an underground hub leading toward the chasm and other areas.
hyps.test: turn on lantern; explore north and south from the cellar
hyps.conclusion: The cellar connects to the Troll Room and East of Chasm, making it part of the underground route.

hyps.name: chasm
hyps.hypothesis: It may require a later method or object to cross.
hyps.test: examine chasm; try crossing it; search nearby passages

hyps.name: gallery
hyps.hypothesis: It contains collectible artwork that awards points.
hyps.test: take painting; examine remaining gallery objects
hyps.conclusion: Taking the gallery painting awards points.

hyps.name: painting
hyps.hypothesis: It is a score-awarding collectible.
hyps.test: take painting; carry it and observe score
hyps.conclusion: The painting is a score-awarding collectible.

hyps.name: paper
hyps.hypothesis: Reading it reveals a completion or ownership message.
hyps.test: take paper; read paper
hyps.conclusion: Reading the paper produces the ownership/congratulations message.

hyps.name: ownership message
hyps.hypothesis: It may signal a success condition or be the game's ending message.
hyps.test: read paper after reaching the studio in a new game

hyps.name: kitchen
hyps.hypothesis: It is the initial interior entry point and connects to other house areas.
hyps.test: enter window; explore kitchen exits

hyps.name: east edge of chasm
hyps.hypothesis: It provides access from the cellar to the gallery.
hyps.test: turn on lantern; south; east

hyps.name: steep metal ramp
hyps.hypothesis: It may lead to another area but is currently unclimbable.
hyps.test: turn on lantern; examine ramp; climb ramp

hyps.name: grue
hyps.hypothesis: Darkness may cause a dangerous creature attack, making illumination necessary.
hyps.test: open trap door; down; wait

hyps.name: dark staircase
hyps.hypothesis: It may provide another route or area within the house.
hyps.test: climb staircase

hyps.name: wooden door with strange gothic lettering
hyps.hypothesis: It may conceal another area, but appears nailed shut.
hyps.test: open wooden door

hyps.name: trophy case
hyps.hypothesis: It may contain a significant collectible or reward.
hyps.test: examine trophy case; open trophy case

hyps.name: open door covered with paint
hyps.hypothesis: It may lead to another area beyond the studio.
hyps.test: go through open door

hyps.name: congratulatory ownership message
hyps.hypothesis: It may mark a major completion milestone or practical ending.
hyps.test: read paper, then continue exploring or issue score

hyps.name: troll
hyps.hypothesis: It blocks passage until defeated with the sword.
hyps.test: attack troll; attack troll; attack troll; then try east and west
hyps.conclusion: Repeated sword attacks defeat the troll and permit passage east.

hyps.name: axe
hyps.hypothesis: It may be a valuable collectible or tool after the troll is defeated.
hyps.test: defeat the troll, drop an item if necessary, then take axe

hyps.name: platinum bar
hyps.hypothesis: It is a collectible that may award points, though the room's noise interferes with commands.
hyps.test: in the Loud Room, try take platinum bar after reducing the room's noise or otherwise solving it

hyps.name: Flood Control Dam #3
hyps.hypothesis: It contains a bolt and control systems that may alter water routes or open further access.
hyps.test: obtain the wrench and try turn bolt with wrench at the Dam
hyps.conclusion: Turning the Dam bolt with the wrench did not open or alter the tested route.

hyps.name: Dam Lobby
hyps.hypothesis: It provides access to private dam rooms and contains a useful guidebook.
hyps.test: from Dam, go north; read guidebook and explore north/east

hyps.name: Maintenance Room
hyps.hypothesis: Its buttons control lights and water, and its tools may solve the dam mechanism.
hyps.test: press buttons carefully, inspect the panel, and try commands involving the screwdriver on the blue button
hyps.conclusion: The explored south-side location cannot cross the chasm northward.

hyps.name: Frobozz Magic Gunk
hyps.hypothesis: It may repair or lubricate a jammed mechanism such as the blue button or dam bolt.
hyps.test: examine tube, then try apply gunk to blue button and turn bolt with wrench after obtaining the wrench

hyps.name: Deep Canyon
hyps.hypothesis: It connects the North-South Passage, Loud Room, Reservoir South, and Dam.
hyps.test: from North-South Passage go northeast, then try east, northwest, southwest, and down

hyps.name: Reservoir South
hyps.hypothesis: It may provide access around the lake or to the dam and chasm routes.
hyps.test: from Deep Canyon go northwest, then explore west, east, and southeast

hyps.name: drowning death
hyps.hypothesis: The water-level sequence is a timed hazard requiring the leak or controls to be stopped before the player drowns.
hyps.test: restart, enter Maintenance Room, press blue, and test a different button sequence while monitoring the water level
hyps.conclusion: The water level rises through successive actions or movement, creating a timed flooding hazard; the transcript confirms the hazard but not a successful solution.

hyps.name: sluice gates
hyps.hypothesis: They may control the dam or water flow and may be relevant to stopping the maintenance-room flooding.
hyps.test: At Dam, examine sluice gates; try open sluice gates, turn sluice gates, or inspect them.

hyps.name: blue button leak
hyps.hypothesis: The jammed blue button may need the screwdriver or another tool to repair or shut off the leak.
hyps.test: In a fresh game, press blue once, then try turn screwdriver, use screwdriver, or other direct screwdriver commands while examining the button.

hyps.name: yellow button
hyps.hypothesis: It may be one of the controls for water flow or maintenance-room machinery.
hyps.test: Press yellow while monitoring the water level, then inspect the panel or try alternate button sequences before flooding rises.

hyps.name: brown button
hyps.hypothesis: It may be another water-control button whose correct sequence is needed to stop the leak.
hyps.test: Press brown in different sequences with yellow after starting the leak, while monitoring the water level.

hyps.name: crack into a passage
hyps.hypothesis: The crack may provide another route, though it may be too small or inaccessible from the current side.
hyps.test: At Chasm, examine crack; try enter crack, go crack, or crawl through crack.

hyps.name: stone stairway
hyps.hypothesis: It is the route back upward from the Loud Room to the Deep Canyon.
hyps.test: At Loud Room, go up and inspect the other exits or nearby rooms.

hyps.name: open door marked Private
hyps.hypothesis: It may lead to additional dam machinery or a route needed for progress.
hyps.test: At Dam Lobby, enter or go through the north Private doorway and then the east Private doorway.

hyps.name: thief
hyps.hypothesis: The thief may steal carried valuables and may need to be confronted or otherwise handled to recover them.
hyps.test: attack thief; examine thief; give painting to thief

hyps.name: north-south passage
hyps.hypothesis: This passage may connect the canyon to another unexplored route.
hyps.test: go southwest from Deep Canyon; go northeast from North-South Passage

hyps.name: flooding death
hyps.hypothesis: The room must be solved or exited before the rising water reaches a lethal level.
hyps.test: after pressing blue button, try exit commands before pressing more controls

hyps.name: north Private doorway
hyps.hypothesis: It may lead to another dam facility area or mechanism.
hyps.test: north

hyps.name: east Private doorway
hyps.hypothesis: It may lead to another private dam area or progression route.
hyps.test: east

hyps.name: steep pathway
hyps.hypothesis: It may provide an alternate route around the chasm.
hyps.test: southwest

hyps.name: neck-level flooding state
hyps.hypothesis: It may require a specific tool or command before the room becomes lethal.
hyps.test: screwdriver blue button

hyps.name: East-West Passage
hyps.hypothesis: A connecting route toward the chasm and reservoir.
hyps.test: from the Troll Room, enter east; then try down

hyps.name: Maintenance-room leak
hyps.hypothesis: A flooding hazard that may require a correctly phrased repair action or another object.
hyps.test: restart, reach the Maintenance Room, and try 'fix blue button with screwdriver' or 'repair blue button' before pressing further controls
hyps.conclusion: The leak can be stopped by opening the gunk tube and applying the viscous material to the active leak; screwdriver repair is unnecessary and ineffective.

hyps.name: Frobozz Magic Gunk tube
hyps.hypothesis: It may be intended to repair or seal the leaking pipe or jammed blue button.
hyps.test: At the leak, try commands such as `open tube`, `squeeze tube`, or `pour gunk on blue button` before the water reaches neck level.

hyps.name: east wall leak
hyps.hypothesis: The leak may be repairable with the gunk, screwdriver, or another tool.
hyps.test: With the tube or screwdriver carried, try `apply gunk to leak`, `pour gunk on leak`, or `repair leak with screwdriver`.
hyps.conclusion: The gunk successfully repairs or seals the active maintenance-room leak when the tube is opened first.

hyps.name: flooding death state
hyps.hypothesis: The rising water imposes a timed hazard requiring the leak to be stopped quickly.
hyps.test: After pressing the blue button, immediately test the gunk or another tool on the leak before pressing more controls.

hyps.name: thief robbery event
hyps.hypothesis: The thief may be triggered by taking valuable objects and can remove them before the flooding puzzle is solved.
hyps.test: After the thief appears, drop or conceal valuable objects and observe whether he leaves without robbing them.

hyps.name: large bag
hyps.hypothesis: It is carried by the thief and may be involved in his robbery behavior.
hyps.test: examine bag

hyps.name: viscous material
hyps.hypothesis: The material from the gunk tube may have a use in stopping or repairing the leak.
hyps.test: apply gunk to blue button

hyps.name: open south studio door
hyps.hypothesis: It may provide a route beyond the studio toward additional areas.
hyps.test: south; open door; enter door

hyps.name: pile of plastic
hyps.hypothesis: It may become a boat when inflated and provide a way across the reservoir or another body of water.
hyps.test: take plastic; find a pump; inflate plastic with pump

hyps.name: valve
hyps.hypothesis: It may be intended to inflate the pile of plastic once the plastic is correctly treated as a boat and placed on the ground.
hyps.test: drop plastic; inflate boat with valve

hyps.name: green bubble
hyps.hypothesis: It may be a significant dam-area object or a clue to operating the dam mechanism.
hyps.test: examine bubble; take bubble

hyps.name: matchbook
hyps.hypothesis: It may provide a clue or be a collectible associated with the dam.
hyps.test: take matchbook; read matchbook

hyps.name: Round Room
hyps.hypothesis: It may provide an alternate route because it has passages in all directions, though several are blocked by cave-ins.
hyps.test: enter Round Room; examine cave-ins; try north, south, east, and west

hyps.name: cave-ins
hyps.hypothesis: The cave-ins may block routes that can be cleared or opened with a tool.
hyps.test: examine cave-ins; move cave-ins; attack cave-ins with axe

hyps.name: slavering fangs of a lurking grue
hyps.hypothesis: This death message confirms that entering or remaining in darkness without effective light is lethal.
hyps.test: enter a dark area without a lit lantern

hyps.name: boat recognition ambiguity
hyps.hypothesis: The pile of plastic may need to be called 'boat' only after a transformation or under a specific parser vocabulary.
hyps.test: drop pile; inflate boat with valve; examine boat; inflate plastic with valve

hyps.name: flooded-room blockage
hyps.hypothesis: Flooding the maintenance room permanently blocks the north and east Private routes from the Dam Lobby during this attempt.
hyps.test: after causing the leak, return to Dam Lobby and try north and east before leaving the dam area

hyps.name: dark return route
hyps.hypothesis: The west route from the dam becomes a lethal dark passage after flooding, so a lit lantern must be secured before taking that route or the route should be avoided.
hyps.test: with lantern already lit, flood the maintenance room, return to Dam, go west, then verify whether the lantern remains usable

hyps.name: Damp Cave
hyps.hypothesis: It may be part of a route to the White Cliffs and another underground objective.
hyps.test: From Loud Room, enter `east`, then test `east`, `west`, and `south` commands.

hyps.name: White Cliffs Beach
hyps.hypothesis: The beach and tight passage may provide access to a new area using a smaller object or a special action.
hyps.test: At White Cliffs Beach, try `enter passage` while carrying an appropriate small item, and test `open passage`, `climb cliffs`, and `south`.

hyps.name: tight passage

goals.theory: The game rewards exploration and collection with score increases, while reaching the studio and reading its paper produces a congratulatory ownership message that may serve as the practical ending.
goals.test: Start a new game, follow the same route to the studio, and check whether reading the paper ends or otherwise completes the game.

goals.theory: The game appears to reward reaching new areas and taking significant objects, while the studio paper provides a major ownership/congratulations milestone; however, unresolved routes and barriers suggest this may not be the maximum-progress ending.
goals.test: Next game, after reading the paper, inspect the score and continue testing the kitchen staircase, nailed-shut wooden door, trophy case, and painted studio door.

goals.theory: Further progress may require solving blocked routes such as the locked grating or the unclimbable metal ramp, after collecting tools and valuable objects.
goals.test: In a new game, return to the clearing after obtaining the canary and test commands such as unlock grating with canary, then investigate the cellar ramp with any newly found tool.

goals.theory: The game appears to reward a combination of exploration, collecting valuable objects, and solving barriers; the congratulatory studio message is a milestone but not proven to be the final maximum-progress state.
goals.test: Next game, continue exploring after reading the studio paper, test the steep pathway and unresolved ramp, and attempt the maintenance-room repair with commands such as 'fix blue button with screwdriver'.

goals.theory: Progress appears to require collecting score-awarding objects and entering important areas while solving environmental barriers without creating unrecoverable hazard states; the studio paper is a milestone, not proven to be the final goal.
goals.test: Replay the route while keeping the lantern usable, avoid flooding or escape immediately, and test whether inflating the plastic boat or opening another blocked route yields further score or progress.
